name: fn.transformer.scope
description: The context and parameter names visible at a position of a transformer or of a composite action sequence, whether a node sits there or not.

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: transformerEnvironmentAt
the root sees the root names
the applyTo of a mapList sees its parent's names
the element transformer of a mapList sees the element as defaultInput
referenceToOuterObject names the element
the predicate of a filterList sees the element
a dataflowObject step sees the steps before it, not itself nor those after it
a new dataflowObject step sees every step
an empty optional slot sees its parent's names
a node deep in the definition of createObjectFromPairs sees its applyTo
the having of an aggregate sees aggregateValue
names add up along the path
parameters do not change along the path
compositeActionEnvironmentAt
the first template sees the parameters
a template sees the templates before it
the first action sees the parameters and the templates
an action sees earlier results by actionLabel, a boxed query's by nameGivenToResult only, not test assertions
a build node sees the parameters and the templates as parameters, and no context
an empty slot of an action is runtime
a transformer in an action binds its names as in a transformer
a runtime transformer of a query sees the query's parameters, its results before it and the action's context
a nested sequence starts with no templates and no earlier results
a step of a nested sequence sees the steps of that sequence before it
the context the caller gives is seen by every action
a Runner's form values are one parameter, under the Runner's name
the body of a composite TransformerDefinition sees its parameters
referencePathAttributeNames
a name bound to an object schema gives its attributes
a path into a nested object gives the nested attributes
a list is crossed by an index
a record is crossed by a key
a scalar has no attributes
an object without declared attributes has none
an unknown name has none
a path past a scalar has none
the interface walk reports the schemas a node sees, with withContext

assertions.label: the second step sees the first
the first step does not see itself
